name: What's Inside??
source: Follow the adventures of four friends as they discover love and acceptance whilst unravelling a curious and sinister mystery.. Player choice determines the path through the narrative and influences character disposition.. Can the girls overcome the challenges of life and love whilst potentially saving all of humanity in the process?? Discover what's truly inside!!
translation: 跟随四个朋友的冒险，他们发现了爱和接受，同时解开了一个好奇而险恶的谜团。玩家的选择决定了叙事的路径并影响角色的性格。女孩们能否克服生活和爱情的挑战，同时有可能在此过程中拯救全人类？发现里面真正的东西！
